summary: Your page has a working contact form and clear practice areas, but a broken phone link, conflicting numbers and no client proof hold it back.

findings.problem: The phone number in the contact section uses a mailto link, not a tel link.
findings.cost: A client who taps your number on a phone opens an email app, not a call.
findings.fix: A working click to call link.

findings.problem: The About section says 2000+ Clients Represented, the statistics say 10K+ Served Clients, and 95% Cases Success Rate has no source.
findings.cost: Conflicting and unsupported numbers weaken trust.

findings.problem: No testimonials appear, the team photos, About image and banner appear to be grey placeholders, and there is no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Clients cannot see who you are or what others say.
findings.fix: Real photos, client quotes and a WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: Typos such as View all Expertises and Still Have Questions ?, Ms. Bini Saroj in one place and Dr. in another, and Learn More repeated on every card.
findings.cost: Small errors and vague buttons cost credibility.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and specific button labels.

redesign: Working click to call and WhatsApp on every page.
Partner profiles with real photos, client quotes and one verified set of figures.
